creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-26, setting up blocker links on a notes repo's board after categorizing its columns. The board has a `waiting` column for cards blocked on people outside the team, and none of the seven categories fits it: `open` would put those cards in `kan ready`, and the others mean something else.

Left uncategorized, the column already behaves right for `ready`: a card blocked by a waiting card stays blocked. But `kan doctor` warns on every such link (`[UNCATEGORIZED_LINK] ... column "waiting", which has no usable category`), so the intended setup is a permanent warning.

Possibly: a `waiting` (or `blocked`) category that is not ready, not done, and valid as a blocker without a doctor warning. Or let doctor skip UNCATEGORIZED_LINK for a column explicitly marked as having no category.
title: A 'waiting on someone else' column fits no category, so doctor warns on every link to it
